what: New lint is only planned for Makefile wiring, not pre-commit
scenario_or_breakage: CI lint runs make lint-only, and relevant-checks delegates to pre-commit on changed files, so lint-awk-multibyte-regex would not run in the enforced lint job or normal relevant-checks path
suggested_fix: Also add a local pre-commit hook for lint-awk-multibyte-regex with pass_filenames false and always_run true, mirroring lint-bare-grep-probe
